all.text: Tresserhorn is Lim-Dûl's fortress, which Chaeska builds twenty years after the Ice Age begins, and the Order of Stromgald besieges it for twenty years in a stalemate.
Jaya follows the trail of the missing Jodah to Tresserhorn and rescues him after he was drugged by Lim-Dûl, and Jodah and Jaya return in 2954 AR and destroy the Lord of Tresserhorn.
The Knights of Stromgald then overpower Chaeska and take over Tresserhorn under Haakon, until the New Argive army destroys it, leaving its ruins to the Sea of Laments.
